macros.name: SSO — Safari quick fixes
macros.body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

Thanks for the detail on Safari. Please try:
1) Clear cookies for {{product.domain}}
2) Allow cross-site tracking for your IdP ({{customer.idp_domain}})
3) Retry in a private window

If it still loops, reply with a HAR from the redirect step and we’ll escalate to engineering.

— {{agent.name}}
